description: Space 0 ekibi olarak, uzay teknolojileri ve gelişmiş kozmik modelleme alanlarında yenilikçi araştırmalar yürüten bir takımız. "Bilinmeyeni Keşfet" vizyonumuz doğrultusunda, teorik bilgiyi derinlemesine mühendislik çözümleriyle birleştirerek bilimsel sınırları zorlamayı hedefliyoruz. Dinamik bir çalışma ortamı sunduğumuz ekibimiz, yüksek etkili projelerde yer almak ve uzay çalışmalarına akademik katkı sağlamak isteyen vizyoner araştırmacıları bir araya getirmeyi amaçlamaktadır.
summary: This game, we will make a rocket. But for the rocket we need to get the pieces. For the pieces we need money. So that there are some questions to gain money. But if you do wrong you will lose money. At the end when the rocket is perfectly ready we send it to Moon. We see the challenge at the questions. It is important because when the rocket is not ready it can explode or crash in the mid air so that it needs to be ready.
details: We answer some questions to get the pieces of the rocket and make the rocket to send it to the moon. We used gemini to make the game and we gave the prompts to make it. It is creative because we answer some questions about space and avioation and gain money by them. In our team everybody worked hard to make the game. Everybody had some thoughts. Of course we had failures during the period but we fixed them and create the game at the end. Also for the story of the game with the help of our group and our teacher we wanted to do like this. But we didn’t use that much coding language for the game but we made perfect prompts for this game.
